ruling.recommended_action: Send to a human reviewer: confirm whether the first off-route segment (F3, 18:46–18:56, +5.66 km) is covered by the rider's 18:43 reply to the Rifle Range Road proposal before it began (F9, F10), since the fare formula turns on that segment; the second segment (F4, 19:03–19:12, +4.78 km) is settled as un-exempted.
ruling.reasoning:
The dispute is a route deviation on a RydeTAXI trip: total charged $61.32, with an excess-distance line of $14.64 for 10.38 km at $1.4100/km, so extra kilometres enter the fare [F5][F8][RD-2]. Two off-route segments exist under RD-1: F3 (18:46–18:56, +5.66 km) and F4 (19:03–19:12, +4.78 km) [F1][F3][F4].

Neither segment has a qualifying incident: no traffic incident is recorded, and the Bukit Timah Expressway / Pan Island Expressway speed-band facts show band 4 (30–39 km/h), which under RD-4(b) cannot exempt a segment on its own [F13][F14][F15][RD-4].

For F3 the code trace leaves the RD-5 scope question open. At 18:42 the driver proposed going round the jam via Rifle Range Road and the rider replied at 18:43, “Sure, your call.” — before the 18:46 segment start, on a complete timestamped chat record [F9][F10][F11]. Nothing in the fact table ties the driven path of F3 to Rifle Range Road, and nothing places it elsewhere either; the driver's post-trip assertion that “the second turn-off was my GPS rerouting” is his own account and cannot supply rider consent [F12]. Under RD-5 with G13, an agreed named road untied to the driven segment is undetermined, and because F3's 5.66 km × $1.4100/km ≈ $7.98 would change the refund amount, this undetermined finding must go to a person rather than be decided by me [F3][F5][RD-5].

For F4 the only rider message is at 18:43, twenty minutes before the 19:03 segment, and read in context it cannot cover a later second turn-off; RD-5 requires the rider's agreement to be sent before the segment it covers, so F4 counts as an un-exempted deviation [F10][F11][F12][F4][RD-1][RD-5]. Its extra km would be refundable, but with F3 undetermined the total cannot be fixed to the cent, so no amount is stated here [F4][F5][RD-2].

F18 records no prior upheld route dispute, so the repeated-breach condition of RD-6 is not met and no account flag is raised [F18][RD-6]. Safety screen: I read the chat (F9, F10), the driver's statement (F12) and the complaint, and found no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, so safety_concern is none [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1]. Evidence is otherwise complete (GPS segments, fare record, full timestamped chat), the gap being only the road-name tie for F3 [F3][F4][F5][F8][F11].
